ask: Bolta says my LinkedIn needs reconnecting. Fix it.

steps.why: Which LinkedIn rows are invalid. The company-page rows copy the personal profile's status, so reconnecting the profile fixes them all. A ghost row would be added without connecting, never a reconnect.
The same link connects and reconnects. It carries no brand: the browser's selected workspace decides, so the user checks it shows Acme first.
Only after the user says done. Valid now: say it's connected. Still invalid: the sign-in went to another brand or a different LinkedIn profile; ask them to check the switcher and try again.
Posts still scheduled for LinkedIn go out at their times on their own after a reconnect: no new yes, no recreating them. Times come back in UTC: show them in the brand clock.

say: LinkedIn is connected again in Acme, and your 2 company pages with it. Your 3 scheduled LinkedIn posts go out as planned, starting Tuesday 9:00 am.
never: Saying it's connected before the second read shows it.
Recreating or re-approving posts that were already scheduled.
Retrying a call that said the key is invalid or expired: that is a reconnect of Bolta itself, not of LinkedIn.
